title: Initial downstream results
protocol: Account-disjoint Czech-bank snapshots. The test set was evaluated once after validation-only model selection. Confidence intervals use 250 account-clustered bootstrap resamples.

cashflow_stress.task_label: Will an account above the train-fitted low-balance threshold cross it within the next 60 days?
cashflow_stress.interpretation: LoRA improved average precision by 0.134 over the tabular baseline and 0.152 over frozen embeddings. Its account-clustered AP interval remains above both frozen and tabular point estimates.

future_value.task_label: Predict log1p of absolute transaction volume during the next 180 days.
future_value.target_note: This is a future transaction-volume proxy, not literal customer lifetime value. MAE is in log-volume units, not currency units.
future_value.interpretation: The selected rank-4 adapter reduces MAE by 19% versus tabular Ridge and 15% versus frozen embeddings. The test MAE interval is clearly below the tabular baseline interval.

loan_trouble.interpretation: The held-out set had eight positive examples and engineered tabular features won. It is not used as a LoRA fine-tuning claim.
